impact.text: Any vault that has a net positive premium on token1 will lose value in the NAV calculation.

precondition_sources.text: The vault has a net positive premium on token1 (short 50,000 USDC, long 20,000 USDC).

intent_sources.text: NAV computed by computeNAV() should reflect the correct premium exposure so that a vault with net positive token1 premium does not lose value in the NAV calculation.
